propositions: Approved documentation batch F08 through F20 requires implementation of seven approved repository recommendation units with specific documentation and metadata corrections.

F08A, F08B, F09, F10, F12, F13, and F19 (three children) must implement documentation updates covering command behavior, installation facts, certificates, import guidance, ADR 0100, MCP summary generation, and configuration contracts.
F20 requires updating the GitHub About description using repository administration tools and verifying exact metadata readback with unchanged files, topics, and homepage.
All repository children must pass local checks, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and receive signed plan-review verification before merge to origin/main.
Rejected items F02, F03, F04 remain excluded and deferred item F05 remains undecided pending future action.
